Time-Lost Sapphire

Item Level: 82

{ Prefix Modifier "Grand" }
Upgrades Radius to Large
{ Prefix Modifier "Mystic" (Tier: 1) — Damage, Caster }
Small Passive Skills in Radius also grant 2(1-2)% increased Spell Damage
{ Suffix Modifier "of Enchanting" (Tier: 1) — Caster, Speed }
Notable Passive Skills in Radius also grant 2(1-2)% increased Cast Speed
--------
Place into an allocated Jewel Socket on the Passive Skill Tree. Right click to remove from the Socket.
